description: Generate AI pitch drafts for multiple contacts in a campaign. Creates variants for review. Drafts are NOT sent -- agents draft, humans send.

key_hook.description: Key hook or angle for all pitches

variant_count.description: Number of variants per contact (default 3, max 5)
